name: Kirk Baird
description: Kirk Baird is a Director at Sigma Prime, a blockchain security and research firm. Over more than eight years in the industry, he has progressed from security engineer and auditor to leading Sigma Prime’s security services, operations and R&D. Kirk has reviewed blockchain implementations across Ethereum, Solana, NEAR, Cosmos and Filecoin, working extensively with Solidity, Rust and Go.
